programme.desc: 'S2/E3 - The Valley Of The Rocks'. Adam, Kru and his 'little' brother Tony follow the path of a failed 1982 Vancouver news team led by a Slumach gold hunter and mystic dowser.

programme.title: Deadman's Curse
programme.desc: 'S2/E4 - The Return To Hidden Valley'. After aborting his mission last season, lone wolf prospector David Muise returns undeterred and looking for a partner.

programme.title: Deadman's Curse
programme.desc: 'S2/E5 - The Body In The Cave'. The final words of a lifelong gold hunter send Adam, Kru and Daryl Friesen through an icy gauntlet high above Pitt Lake.

programme.title: Jesus: His Life
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Joseph: The Nativity'. A simple craftsman named Joseph faces a personal test of faith in the small town of Nazareth, when his fiancée Mary tells him she is expecting a child, who is the Son of God.

programme.title: Jesus: His Life
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - John the Baptist: The Mission'. 30 years after Jesus is born, his life intersects with that of John the Baptist, a radical preaching in the desert against Judea's rulers, including Herod's son, Herod Antipas.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: 'S15/E18 - Power Of The Talisman'. Talismans are seen as providing protection and good fortune. Some are even thought to embody a higher power. Could it be a real connection to something beyond our world?

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: 'S16/E1 - The Top Ten Alien Influencers'. Did a biblical patriarch receive instructions from 200 angels high above the earth? Were the ancient Greeks taught how to work metal by a race of fish-people?

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: 'S16/E2 - The Top Ten Extraordinary Creatures'. Giorgio Tsoukalos takes a look at The Top Ten Extraordinary Creatures we've investigated - creatures that might provide evidence of extraterrestrial visitation.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: 'S16/E3 - The Top Ten Hidden Alien Bases'. Ancient Aliens is counting down the top ten locations around the world that might be hiding alien bases, including a cavern beneath the ice of Antarctica, and a lake in China.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: 'S16/E4 - The Top Ten Scariest Encounters'. Ancient Aliens is counting down the top ten scariest encounters that just might be evidence of extraterrestrial visitation.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: 'S17/E11 - The Birdman Mystery'. Throughout the ancient world, there are depictions of mysterious figures that appear to be half human and half bird. In many cultures, they are revered as divine and have magical abilities.

programme.title: History's Greatest Mysteries

programme.title: Sitting Bull

programme.title: IGNITION GT

programme.title: Rev

programme.title: The Bike Show

programme.title: IGNITION Goes To SEMA

programme.title: Razor Customs

programme.title: Buyer's Guide
